ways.label: Whakahoro to Mangapurua Landing

via.name: Mosley homestead site near the Waione Stream

evidence: Whakahoro to Mangapurua Landing: 13 hours (6 hours to Mangapurua/Kaiwhakauka junction)
Follow the Kaiwhakauka Track along a farm road through Retaruke Station (private land), following the true right of the Kaiwhakauka Stream to the large stock and pedestrian bridge.
Note: River transport is necessary to and from the Mangapurua Landing and jetboats can be hired to carry your party either to Pipiriki or back to Whakahoro.

ways.label: Ruatītī Road end to Mangapurua Landing
evidence: Ruatītī Road end to Mangapurua Landing: 11 hours 4 hours to Mangapurua/Kaiwhakauka junction)
Accessed from Ruatītī Road, the track climbs gently from the gate at the road end through private farmland, regenerating scrub and pockets of native bush.

ways.label: Cycle option: Ruatītī Road over to Whakahoro via the Kaiwhakauka Track
evidence: From Ruatītī Road over to Whakahoro via the Kaiwhakauka Track or vice versa.

access_points.name: Mangapurua Landing (by boat from the Whanganui River)
access_points.quote: The track can also be accessed by boat from the Whanganui River at the Mangapurua Landing.

side_trips.name: Cleared viewpoint
side_trips.quote: A sidetrack leads up to a cleared viewpoint.

side_trips.name: Waterfall up Waterfall Creek
side_trips.quote: A 1.5 km side trip up the true left of the creek provides views of the waterfall.

doubts: W1 start: the text says Whakahoro and that the walk follows the Kaiwhakauka Track along a farm road; I gave F1, where Kaiwhakauka Track meets Te Mata Road, which is some way south of the Whakahoro place (T11) and F2/F3 on Oio Road; the text does not say where the farm road begins. W2 start: Ruatītī Road end is taken as F4 (Mangapurua Track at Crotons Road); the road name in the feature differs from the text. DOC's distance '35.5 | 40 km one way' covers both ways but is not split per way in the text, so per-way distance is null; the per-way times come from the summary list. The tracks can be walked either direction; only these directions are described. W3 is a one-day mountain-bike option given in the page; included as another way, but it is a cycling option. The Mangapurua Trig may correspond to the peak 'Mangapurua' (T4) but this is not certain.
